positive_control.evidence: Same run and method: the dialog and the drag both changed the lead (toasts 'Lead technician updated' / 'Lead technician removed'); the same overlay reader captured the Schedule picker ('Entire work order / Choose lines / Create 1 shift'), the Reassign dialog and the toasts (wob48.log, wob49.log), so it does see dialogs.

tried_through_the_screen.evidence: Real UI: Schedule > Fri Oct 9 > dragged S2-13556 (2 lines) onto Brent Avila's row at 9 AM > picker 'Entire work order' > 'Create 1 shift'; then Work Orders > Tech View > row More actions > Reassign lead technician > Bilal Muzamil > Reassign; then Board View card dragged to Unassigned.

waited_and_retried.evidence: Two whole-work-order attempts on two routes (wob48 dialog, wob49 drag), overlay polled every 0.5 s for 3 s; plus three earlier single-line attempts. Never a question, only the toast.

checked_for_navigation.evidence: URL stayed /workorders?search=S2-13556; no new tab; screenshots clear-shifts-prompt.png and clear-shifts-wholewo-try2.png show only the toast.

precondition_read_back.evidence: Schedule board read back: shift 4d4a0445 for Brent Avila 2026-10-09 15:15-17:45Z on S2-13556 listing BOTH lines (whole work order), present before and after each lead change (sched-board.json reads). Reassign dialog showed Brent Avila 'Current' before each attempt.

searched_the_repo.evidence: git grep 'scheduled shifts' / 'Keep shifts' under build/: only our own case text and the observed-labels 'NOT observed' note; ls build/BLOCKED-*.md: nothing on shifts or the Schedule.

asked_what_would_make_this_my_fault.evidence: My first try WAS my fault (single-line work order, so the shift was a line shift, which the cases say gives no prompt; and on another try the shift was on a line technician, not the lead).
